name: Kraken
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Kraken is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Kraken is the cryptocurrency exchange operated by Payward, Inc., a privately held company. Payward's shares are not publicly traded and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, an $800 million raise announced on November 18, 2025, valued the company at $20 billion.

Founded in 2011, Kraken offers trading in digital assets and related products to retail and institutional clients. Payward submitted a confidential draft registration statement for an initial public offering in November 2025 but has not completed a listing. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Kraken
table_note: The September 2025 figures are as reported by Fortune. The November 2025 raise included a $200 million investment by Citadel Securities at the same valuation.
round_notes: In April 2026, Deutsche Börse Group bought a stake in Kraken from existing shareholders for $200 million. Bloomberg reported that the price implied a valuation of $13.3 billion. Because the shares came from existing holders rather than the company, the purchase was not a financing and is not shown in the table.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Investors in the November 2025 raise included Jane Street, DRW Venture Capital, HSG, Oppenheimer Alternative Investment Management and Tribe Capital, followed by Citadel Securities. Deutsche Börse Group became a shareholder in April 2026.
spv_sentence: Since 2020, 55 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Kraken have filed with the SEC, 14 of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Kraken's announcement of its $800 million raise; Deutsche Börse's announcement of its investment; reports by Fortune (September 2025), CoinDesk (March 2026) and The Block (April 2026); reports by Bloomberg; and SEC Form D filings.
